fields.title: Nusantara Defense
fields.description: A tower defense game that turns regional myths and iconography into playable units. I wrote the ability system and the three modes: Story, Infinite, and Challenge.
fields.cover_alt: Nusantara Defense title art beside three unit cards and a gameplay screen

fields.title: URBAN
fields.description: The site for UI Road To Banyumas, the outreach program I run at Clubban UI. Schedule, materials, and merch orders in one place.
fields.cover_alt: URBAN landing page next to its merchandise ordering screen

fields.title: ZidoCT
fields.description: Translates speech inside VRChat while it is being said. Recognition runs on the device so the delay stays short enough to hold a conversation.
fields.cover_alt: ZidoCT translating a spoken sentence from English into Indonesian

fields.title: Pacilator
fields.description: Translates documents, subtitles, and video files. Tuned so the output reads like a person wrote it rather than a dictionary.
fields.cover_alt: Pacilator drop area for subtitle and document files over its split-face logo

fields.title: SCERA
fields.description: Scrapes the UI student portal and rebuilds my timetable as something readable.
fields.cover_alt: SCERA weekly timetable rebuilt from the UI student portal

fields.title: RESIK
fields.description: Photograph a piece of household waste, get it identified, book a pickup, collect points.
fields.cover_alt: RESIK home screen held in one hand, with pickup and article screens behind it
